starchitect.c.comfort.0.0: The interior is empty. Not a bed, not a chest, not even a chair. Do you sleep standing up?
starchitect.c.comfort.0.1: Interior: nothing. The echo of my footsteps was my only company.
starchitect.c.comfort.1.0: %1$s kind(s) of furniture: livable, barely. It'll take more than "%2$s" to make it a home.
starchitect.c.comfort.1.1: The interior is spartan. Functional, let's say.
starchitect.c.comfort.2.0: A thoughtful interior: %1$s kinds of furniture, and it feels like home.
starchitect.c.comfort.2.1: You want to drop your bags and stay. Starting with "%2$s", everything is in its place.
starchitect.c.comfort.3.0: The interior is sumptuous: %1$s kinds of furniture, every corner tells a story.
starchitect.c.comfort.3.1: A magazine-worthy interior. I sat down and nearly never left.
starchitect.c.detail.0.0: Walls as flat as a pancake: barely %1$s%% depth. A stair, a slab, a trapdoor… anything!
starchitect.c.detail.0.1: No depth whatsoever. The facade has all the relief of a billboard.
starchitect.c.detail.1.0: A few details (%1$s%% depth) try to break the monotony. They are understaffed.
starchitect.c.detail.1.1: The depth is shy, as if asking permission to exist.
starchitect.c.detail.2.0: Real work on depth: walls, slabs and stairs give the facade character.
starchitect.c.detail.2.1: The facade breathes thanks to %1$s%% of well-placed detail blocks.
starchitect.c.detail.3.0: The depth is carved with a jeweller's precision. Every shadow is where it belongs.
starchitect.c.detail.3.1: Stairs, slabs, walls: %1$s%% detail, and not one too many. High art.
starchitect.c.garden.0.0: Not a flower, not a hedge. The garden is the lawn… barely.
starchitect.c.garden.0.1: Nothing grows around it. Even the bees turned back.
starchitect.c.garden.1.0: A few plants (%1$s) do their best to brighten the surroundings.
starchitect.c.garden.1.1: The garden exists, timidly. One more flower wouldn't hurt.
starchitect.c.garden.2.0: A pretty garden: %1$s plants that soften the silhouette.
starchitect.c.garden.2.1: The surroundings are tidy, flowery, welcoming.
starchitect.c.garden.3.0: The garden is a poem: %1$s plants, and not a single weed.
starchitect.c.garden.3.1: I spent more time in the garden than in the house, and I don't regret it.
starchitect.c.light.0.0: Lighting? %1$s spots in pitch darkness. The zombies have already signed the lease.
starchitect.c.light.0.1: It's so dark inside I wrote this review by touch.
starchitect.c.light.1.0: %2$s light source(s) is a start; there are still %1$s corners where a creeper could nap.
starchitect.c.light.1.1: Approximate lighting: you can see, but you'd rather not look too closely.
starchitect.c.light.2.0: Careful, warm lighting that invites you in.
starchitect.c.light.2.1: %2$s well-placed light sources: no monster would dare.
starchitect.c.light.3.0: The light is staged like a theatre. Not one shadow too many, not a monster in sight.
starchitect.c.light.3.1: Lighting this right is rare. Even my travel candle felt useless.
starchitect.c.palette.0.0: The palette? %2$s, then more %2$s: %3$s%% of the facade. The eye falls asleep before reaching the door.
starchitect.c.palette.0.1: %1$s material(s) in total. At this point it's not a palette, it's a uniform.
starchitect.c.palette.1.0: With %1$s materials, the palette is still finding itself; %2$s rather crushes the rest.
starchitect.c.palette.1.1: The materials chat politely without really getting along. %2$s leads the conversation.
starchitect.c.palette.2.0: A fine palette: %1$s materials playing together, with %2$s conducting.
starchitect.c.palette.2.1: Tasteful choice of materials, and %2$s knows its place.
starchitect.c.palette.3.0: The palette is a masterclass: %1$s materials in perfect harmony. I took notes.
starchitect.c.palette.3.1: Every block seems to have passed a job interview. %2$s, in particular, is flawless.
starchitect.c.roof.0.0: The roof, conspicuously absent. Or a flat lid plonked on top like a shoebox.
starchitect.c.roof.0.1: Flat roof, flat ambitions. The rain, however, is delighted.
starchitect.c.roof.1.0: The roof can't decide between sloped and flat (%1$s%% sloped). Pick one.
starchitect.c.roof.1.1: A decent roof, nothing more: it protects, it says nothing.
starchitect.c.roof.2.0: A fine sloped roof that finally gives the whole thing a silhouette.
starchitect.c.roof.2.1: The roof is well drawn; you'd recognise it from afar.
starchitect.c.roof.3.0: The roof is a marvel: true slopes, a crisp ridge. I took my hat off.
starchitect.c.roof.3.1: A postcard-worthy roof. %1$s%% slopes, zero mistakes.
starchitect.c.symmetry.0.0: Symmetry has been banished; you never know which side to look at.
starchitect.c.symmetry.0.1: Each side seems to have been built by someone who never met the other.
starchitect.c.symmetry.1.0: %1$s%% symmetry: the intent is there, the ruler less so.
starchitect.c.symmetry.1.1: It stands more or less upright, like a villager after a party.
starchitect.c.symmetry.2.0: A balanced composition, %1$s%% symmetrical, without being stiff.
starchitect.c.symmetry.2.1: The volumes answer each other elegantly.
starchitect.c.symmetry.3.0: %1$s%% symmetry. I folded the plan in half: everything lines up.
starchitect.c.symmetry.3.1: Perfect balance. You could put a mirror in the middle and not notice.
starchitect.c.windows.0.0: Windows? None, or nearly. It feels like living in a chest.
starchitect.c.windows.0.1: Without windows, a house is just a cupboard with ambitions.
starchitect.c.windows.1.0: %2$s glass block(s): the light gets in, but on tiptoe.
starchitect.c.windows.1.1: The windows are there, a little lost in the facade, like guests who don't know anyone.
starchitect.c.windows.2.0: Lovely openings (%1$s%% glazing): the facade has a gaze.
starchitect.c.windows.2.1: Well-proportioned windows: you can see outside, which is already a lot.
starchitect.c.windows.3.0: The windows are perfectly measured. Light enters like a guest of honour.
starchitect.c.windows.3.1: %1$s%% glazing, ideally placed. I spent an hour just looking at the view.

starchitect.hate.augustin.0: Alas, %1$s everywhere. I have nothing against it, except everything.
starchitect.hate.augustin.1: What is the %1$s doing here? It has no place in a self-respecting home.
starchitect.hate.brigitte.0: Material-wise, %1$s dominates. It feels like a tourist chalet.
starchitect.hate.brigitte.1: There's an excess of %1$s. I prefer materials that don't creak.
starchitect.hate.gaston.0: Alas, the %1$s, so cold… It looks like a train station.
starchitect.hate.gaston.1: Why %1$s? We're not in the city!
starchitect.hate.zoe.1: And the %1$s? Seriously? Even my grandparents have moved on.
starchitect.headline.0.1: %s: the void finally hired an architect
starchitect.headline.0.2: %s, or the art of wasting blocks
starchitect.headline.2.1: %s: we'd happily spend the night (no mobs)
starchitect.headline.3.2: %s: three stars and a dropped monocle
starchitect.headline.dirt.0: %s: dirt, more dirt, nothing but dirt
starchitect.headline.dirt.1: %s: even the Stone Age was made of stone
starchitect.intro.augustin.0: I arrived %1$s, %2$s, monocle firmly in place, before %3$s.
starchitect.intro.augustin.1: It was %1$s, %2$s, that I stepped into %3$s, critic's gloves on.
starchitect.intro.augustin.2: I had heard of %3$s. I went %1$s, %2$s, unannounced, as always.
starchitect.intro.brigitte.0: Inspected %3$s %1$s, %2$s. I brought my spirit level.
starchitect.intro.brigitte.1: %3$s. Inspection %1$s, %2$s. I did not come here to be charmed.
starchitect.intro.brigitte.2: Concrete never lies. Builders do. I met %3$s %1$s, %2$s.
starchitect.intro.gaston.0: I stopped by %3$s %1$s, %2$s, boots on and basket in hand.
starchitect.intro.gaston.1: Ah, %3$s! I went %1$s, %2$s, following the smell of a wood fire.
starchitect.intro.gaston.2: Nothing beats a visit %1$s, %2$s. Off to %3$s, across the fields.
starchitect.intro.zoe.0: Visited %3$s %1$s, %2$s. My followers have been waiting for this.
starchitect.intro.zoe.1: %3$s, %1$s, %2$s: my camera was out before I even got in.
starchitect.intro.zoe.2: I was promised design. Verdict at %3$s, %1$s, %2$s.
starchitect.love.augustin.0: And then there's the %1$s: noble, timeless, exactly my taste.
starchitect.love.augustin.1: I noted the %1$s with a smile, which is rare.
starchitect.love.brigitte.0: Material-wise, %1$s, raw and unashamed: finally some courage.
starchitect.love.brigitte.1: I saluted the %1$s, used without frills.
starchitect.love.gaston.0: And then the %1$s! It smells of the countryside, I'm tearing up.
starchitect.love.gaston.1: I love the %1$s here: it feels authentic.
starchitect.love.zoe.0: Special mention for the %1$s: very on-trend, very photogenic.
starchitect.love.zoe.1: I adore the %1$s here. It'll go viral.
starchitect.msg.cancel: The visit is off: you wandered too far away.
starchitect.msg.nothing.0: %s looks around for a build, finds only scenery, and leaves with a sigh.
starchitect.msg.nothing.1: %s walked the whole area: not a build in sight. Nature, at least, needs no review.
starchitect.msg.rumor: Rumour has it a critic is lurking nearby…
starchitect.photo.caption: Photo: our special correspondent
starchitect.photo.none: No photo: the photographer was on strike
starchitect.remark.bling.0: Precious blocks on the facade. Good taste is priceless; apparently the opposite isn't.
starchitect.remark.bling.1: Gold, diamond, emerald… Someone confused a house with a vault.
starchitect.remark.cat.0: A cat lives here. The cat, at least, deserves three stars.
starchitect.remark.cat.1: I was greeted by a cat, who judged me harder than I'm judging the house.
starchitect.remark.cobble.0: Smooth stone exists, you know. So does the furnace. Together they work wonders.
starchitect.remark.cobble.1: So much cobblestone… This is a first-night shelter that never moved on.
starchitect.remark.dirt.0: A dirt hut. Dirt. The jury allows me to award the Golden Dirt Hut, an honour that honours no one.
starchitect.remark.dirt.1: I've seen more ambitious rabbit holes. At least rabbits dig.
starchitect.remark.dog.0: A loyal dog guards the house. It sniffed my notebook suspiciously.
starchitect.remark.dog.1: The house dog gave me a warm welcome. One extra point for him.
starchitect.remark.giant.0: %1$s blocks! I needed a minecart to get from the living room to the kitchen.
starchitect.remark.giant.1: A %1$s-block building: it took me two days to walk around it.
starchitect.remark.golem.0: An iron golem watches over the place. I behaved.
starchitect.remark.golem.1: The presence of an iron golem makes any review more… diplomatic.
starchitect.remark.greenhouse.0: More glass than wall: living here is like living in an aquarium.
starchitect.remark.horse.0: A steed waits by the door: finally, a sense of hospitality.
starchitect.remark.horse.1: There's even a horse. The parking is well designed.
starchitect.remark.mobs.0: I counted %1$s spots dark enough to spawn a monster. I left running.
starchitect.remark.mobs.1: With %1$s pitch-dark corners, this isn't a house, it's a mob farm.
starchitect.remark.nodoor.0: Fun detail: there is no door. How did I even get in?
starchitect.remark.nodoor.1: No door. Great for drafts, less so for zombies.
starchitect.remark.noroof.0: Not a single covered room. Is it a house or a sculpture? I'll say sculpture, out of kindness.
starchitect.remark.noroof.1: Nothing is covered: at the first storm, everyone out… which changes nothing.
starchitect.remark.parrot.0: A parrot repeated my notes out loud. I had to soften them.
starchitect.remark.parrot.1: The house parrot called me a "crrritic". Fair enough.
starchitect.remark.rainbow.0: %1$s different colours! I thought I'd walked into a box of crayons.
starchitect.remark.rainbow.1: The facade has %1$s colours. My eyes are filing for sick leave.
starchitect.remark.tiny.0: %1$s blocks in all. Small, but I'm not here to measure. Well, I am.
starchitect.remark.tiny.1: It's tiny (%1$s blocks). Charming or lazy: I haven't decided.
starchitect.remark.tower.0: %1$s blocks tall! Vertigo is part of the experience.
starchitect.remark.tower.1: A %1$s-block tower: you go up, you come down, you think about it.
starchitect.remark.villager.0: Villagers are wandering around. They seem satisfied, but they're satisfied with anything.
starchitect.remark.villager.1: A villager offered me three emeralds for a good review. Declined.
starchitect.revisit.down.0: Visit #%3$s, and I already miss the last one: down from %1$s to %2$s star(s).
starchitect.revisit.down.1: What happened here? Last time it was %1$s star(s).
starchitect.revisit.same.0: Visit #%3$s. Changes, yes. Progress… that's another story.
starchitect.revisit.same.1: I come back, I look, I sigh: still %2$s star(s).
starchitect.revisit.up.0: This is visit #%3$s, and what progress: from %1$s to %2$s star(s). Someone listened.
starchitect.revisit.up.1: On visit #%3$s, I barely recognised the place. In a good way.
starchitect.show.none: No dark spot to show: everything is lit.
starchitect.show.started: %s dark spots marked in red for 30 seconds.
starchitect.styleline.brutalist.0: Brutalist style: concrete, stone, and not a single concession to prettiness.
starchitect.styleline.classic.0: A classic style, all in stone: sober, solid, timeless.
starchitect.styleline.desert.0: A desert style, all sandstone and terracotta: my eyes searched for the camel.
starchitect.styleline.eclectic.0: The style? Eclectic, let's say. Each wall seems to come from a different era.
starchitect.styleline.industrial.0: Industrial style: iron and copper give the whole thing a steam-factory air.
starchitect.styleline.infernal.0: The style? Infernal Gothic: you can feel the Nether's heat in the very walls.
starchitect.styleline.japanese.0: The Japanese style is fully embraced: pale wood, crisp lines, a certain idea of serenity.
starchitect.styleline.medieval.0: The style is medieval: stone below, timber above, like in the good old days of castles.
starchitect.styleline.modern.0: A resolutely modern style: pale concrete, quartz and large bay windows.
starchitect.styleline.nordic.0: A Nordic style: dark spruce, a stone base and a steep roof for the snow.
starchitect.styleline.rustic.0: Rustic style: wood, wood and more wood, like a mountain chalet.
starchitect.styleline.tropical.0: A tropical style: jungle and acacia wood, you can almost hear the parrots.
starchitect.styleline.whimsical.0: The style is whimsical, straight out of a fairy tale: bright colours and precious materials.
starchitect.stylelove.augustin.0: The %1$s style, at last! It reconciles me with my era.
starchitect.stylelove.brigitte.0: The %1$s style: exactly what I have championed for thirty years.
starchitect.stylelove.gaston.0: Ah, the %1$s style… It reminds me of my grandfather's farm.
starchitect.stylelove.zoe.0: The %1$s style is so me. One hundred percent approved.
starchitect.think.15: Don't touch anything. Don't touch anything.
starchitect.think.9: Interesting. Not in a good way.
starchitect.tip.comfort: Furnish the inside (%1$s kind(s) of furniture): bed, chest, crafting table, bookshelf, painting, flower pot…
starchitect.tip.detail: Dress up the facade: about %1$s more stairs, slabs, walls or trapdoors (cornices, sills, beams).
starchitect.tip.dirt: Replace the dirt: planks, stone bricks, anything else.
starchitect.tip.garden: Plant things around it (%1$s plant(s)): flowers, leaf hedges, a vegetable patch, a path.
starchitect.tip.light: Light up the %1$s pitch-dark spots (the "Show me" button marks them in red).
starchitect.tip.light.none: Add a few lanterns or torches: a house with no light welcomes no one.
starchitect.tip.none: Nothing to add. Above all, don't touch a thing!
starchitect.tip.palette.dominant: %1$s makes up %2$s%% of the build: break it up with another material for corners and edges.
starchitect.tip.palette.few: Add two or three materials to go with %1$s: a stone base, beams, window frames.
starchitect.tip.palette.many: %1$s materials is too many: keep six or seven that go together.
starchitect.tip.roof: Swap the flat roof for sloping stairs, with a row of slabs on the ridge.
starchitect.tip.roof.none: Put a roof on it: stairs, sloping down on both sides.
starchitect.tip.symmetry: Balance both halves of the facade: same windows, same width on each side.
starchitect.tip.windows: Add about %1$s more windows (glass or glass panes).
starchitect.tip.windows.many: Too much glass: swap a few panes for solid wall.
starchitect.verdict.0.0: Verdict: no star for %1$s. But it's never too late to learn.
starchitect.verdict.0.1: No star. I'll come back… if forced to.
starchitect.verdict.1.0: Verdict: one star. %1$s is worth a short walk, at a leisurely pace.
starchitect.verdict.1.1: One star, earned. The work continues, and I'm curious what comes next.
starchitect.verdict.2.0: Verdict: two stars. %1$s is worth a minecart detour.
starchitect.verdict.2.1: Two stars, with the jury's compliments. Very little stands between this and glory.
starchitect.verdict.3.0: Verdict: three stars. %1$s is worth an elytra trip.
starchitect.verdict.3.1: Three stars. I'm putting my monocle away: there's nothing left to criticise.
starchitect.verdict.dirt.0: Verdict: the Golden Dirt Hut. Congratulations? No.
starchitect.verdict.dirt.1: Verdict: no stars, but an honorary shovel, to rebuild everything.
